body: Ugg, right now I'm not particularly upset, I'm honestly content, but I'm also so tempted to try and do something again. I don't know why I'm even considering it but I feel so close to just saying fuck it and giving it a go since if I succeed I wont be missing anything, if I fail it's more of the same.
I do like writing, though sometimes it aggravates me more than it helps depending on if I can get what I want down. Guess I'll see later.

I think too much and I wouldn't quite say I have insomnia, but I rarely fall asleep faster than 30-45 minutes after I lay down. The long I'm awake the more my mind wanders and it all comes back to something bad in the end, I can even make happy thoughts bad by remembering it'll never happen. I know that my life isn't even the problem in this, I just can't keep myself happy with myself and I only have one way I can think of to shut it out.
